audit.why: Chart and breakdown.difficulty agree on Seraphine winning levels 1-5, Kog'Maw taking over at first item — full phases[].side and content win[] already match.
Spikes correctly cover lvl3-5 poke dominance, lvl6 Encore all-in, 1st on-hit item flip, and late max-range DPS.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect flags that Kog'Maw's other three abilities (Caustic Spittle, Void Ooze, Living Artillery) and his passive Icathian Surprise are never named anywhere on the page — only Bio-Arcane Barrage (W) appears, and breakdown.cooldowns carries no real number.
audit.why: Icathian Surprise deals true damage on a 4s delay after Kog'Maw dies — the missingInteractions entry confirms stacking armor/MR does nothing against it. His Q Caustic Spittle (7s CD) shreds resists further and his E Void Ooze (12s CD) is his only slow/poke tool worth tracking a cooldown on.
audit.corrected: Name Caustic Spittle, Void Ooze, and Icathian Surprise with real cooldowns/behavior in breakdown.cooldowns and a Don't, since the true-damage passive means building pure armor is the wrong answer.

edits.before: - Kog'Maw Bio-Arcane Barrage: matchup-defining — The range + shred window IS the champion — disengage for its eight seconds, fight the gaps. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Beat Drop like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kog'Maw's W Bio-Arcane Barrage (17s CD): the range + shred window IS the champion — disengage for its duration, fight the gaps. - His Q Caustic Spittle is only 7s CD and corrodes resists; his E Void Ooze (12s CD) is the slow to track. - Guard your own E Beat Drop (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: That is Kog'Maw’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Ignoring his passive Icathian Surprise — he explodes for true damage 4s after dying, so armor and MR do nothing to soften it; back off the corpse.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: He has no dash and no escape (E Void Ooze is a poke tool, not mobility) — chain E Beat Drop into Q for a slow that sticks the whole time it lasts.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Standing in his Void Ooze (E) trail to fight — it slows anyone standing on it, turning a poke trade into a kill for a champion with zero mobility of his own to punish for it.

notes: The packet defect (never names Kog'Maw's abilities) was only partly true — the content layer already names Caustic Spittle/Void Ooze contextually and W is named throughout, but breakdown.cooldowns (full layer) carried no digit and never named Q/E/P. Added real cooldowns (Q 7s, W 17s, E 12s) and the true-damage Icathian Surprise passive, sourced from missingInteractions' resistances-invalidated flag. Chart already agrees between layers; no side/win edits needed. Fixed both COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets with matchup-grounded replacements.
